rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance – annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-stabilized units, a landlord may raise rent only once every 12 months, by the allowable percentage set by the city. Since February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer add a utilities percentage or a 10% increase for an added dependent; a 10% increase for an added non-dependent tenant is still allowed.
rules.requirement_es: En unidades con estabilización de rentas, el propietario solo puede aumentar la renta una vez cada 12 meses, según el porcentaje permitido por la ciudad. Desde el 2 de febrero de 2026 ya no se puede añadir un porcentaje por servicios públicos ni un 10% por un dependiente adicional; sí se permite un 10% por un inquilino adicional que no sea dependiente.

rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978 (plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28): apartments, duplexes, two or more single-family units on a parcel, hotel/rooming house rooms occupied over 30 days, ADUs/JADUs, mobile homes. Condominiums and townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commenced after December 31, 1995.
rules.exemptions: Rent may rise to market when the tenant voluntarily moves out or is evicted for non-payment or lease violation; Luxury Exemption available by application.
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by the allowable percentage
rules.caveat: Official page gives no specific percentage (linked PDF) and no original RSO effective date; February 2, 2026 changes are noted in the page.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO – legal reasons for eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized units may evict only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. No-fault evictions require a Declaration of Intent to Evict filed with LAHD, 30-day and 60-day written notices (sometimes 120 days or a one-year extension), and payment of tenant relocation assistance.
rules.requirement_es: Los propietarios de unidades con estabilización de rentas solo pueden desalojar por las causas permitidas, con falta del inquilino o sin ella. Los desalojos sin culpa exigen presentar una Declaración de Intención de Desalojar ante LAHD, avisos escritos de 30 y 60 días (a veces 120 días o una prórroga de un año) y el pago de asistencia de reubicación.
rules.quoted_span: Give the tenant a 30-day and 60-day written notice (some evictions require 120-day notice or up to a 1-year extension).
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the RSO (first built on or before October 1, 1978); non-RSO units are covered by the separate Just Cause Ordinance.
rules.key_value: 30-day and 60-day written notice; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.caveat: Summary page; eviction notices must also be filed with LAHD within three business days of service (LAMC 151.09.C.9).
